POLITICAL TRANSITIONS ATLAS — S011 EXECUTION PROMPT
Requested by Hugh Lamarque on 13 November 2026.

Objective
Bring every geographic case to a defensible full-period check, resolve the remaining partial sequences wherever the evidence permits, sense-check the entire register, and make all current public prose clear, concise, neutral and readable. Use the published S010 register as the frozen baseline: 676 office/authority handovers, 68 separate collective changes, 197 geographic cases, 162 fully checked countries and 35 partial countries. Preserve the fixed event window, 11 November 2016–11 November 2026 inclusive.

Coverage research
Start from the exact 44 partial office/authority chains and 72 open questions. Assign every remaining country once. For each gap, state the proposition that prevents closure and the evidence that would settle it. Follow the best untried route: original legal instruments and amendments, appointment and dismissal records, official cabinet or council lists, parliamentary proceedings, archived official chronologies, and reliable contemporary reporting in the relevant language. Read the actual source bodies. Reuse unchanged verified evidence instead of repeating searches for their own sake.

Resolve opening holders, intervening changes and interruptions, parallel authority, collective membership, and the endpoint. Check whether a supposed gap is actually an unresolved factual issue, a mistaken office boundary, or an excessive evidential demand. Apply the existing protocol consistently. Binding legal continuity rules combined with date-specific evidence can support an explained determination; neither a current title alone nor absence of search results proves a complete sequence. Do not require an unknowable guarantee that no unreported event occurred. Do not remove positive contrary evidence, invent holders or dates, or redefine the project to achieve a desired status.

When evidence supports closure, complete the office ledger and its source trail, resolve the related follow-up questions, and derive country status from all relevant office chains. Exclude a body only through a sourced assessment under the existing executive-headship rule. Keep personal/authority handovers and collective-composition changes separate. Preserve stable IDs, episode links, supported date intervals and sensitivity alternatives. If a gap remains genuinely unresolved after the targeted investigation, retain the qualification with a plain explanation and the precise missing evidence. Completion of a research pass must not be presented as proof of a complete sequence.

Substantive sense check
Reconcile all records, countries, office chains, date bounds and totals. Review chronology, predecessors/successors, vacancies and overlaps, duplicates and linked episodes, mechanisms, executive scope, source support and governing-group coding. Recheck surprising recent claims and investigate any pattern of errors. A different agent must open the supporting sources for every proposed new or changed core factual claim and every coverage upgrade. Record corrections, disagreements, access failures and common-source dependence. Reuse the earlier reviews for unchanged claims and describe fresh checks accurately.

Prose
Review every current public event summary, date explanation and caveat; collective-change description; country and office coverage note; follow-up reason and action; and the website's overview, analysis, methods, labels, tooltips and download descriptions. Edit the workbook and methodology report to match. Explain what happened first: who replaced whom, in which office, and why or how when established. Use short complete sentences, active verbs, consistent names and plain English. Expand unexplained abbreviations, repair missing spaces, remove internal process jargon and repetitive disclaimers, and state uncertainty next to the particular fact it qualifies. Use neutral descriptions; distinguish a change of officeholder from a change of governing party or political system. Preserve every material fact, qualification, source link and distinction between unknown and vacant. Source titles and historical audit records are evidence and must not be cosmetically rewritten. An editor other than the drafter must check that substantive meaning and uncertainty survive each proposed public-text edit.

Delivery and validation
Integrate reviewed factual and prose patches into S011, preserving S010 and the original audit history. Compute all statistics from the adopted records. Regenerate the research workbook, methodology report, complete working archive and website data. Retain Mechanism as the default and Reset view, the existing atlas design and the current audience. Check desktop and mobile presentation and the affected filters, source dialogs and exports. Validate the Office files and inspect changed layouts. Publish the existing Site and update the existing deliverables. Save this prompt, a country-by-country closure register, separate review decisions, a prose change log and final validation. Report the actual coverage achieved, additions/corrections, prose changes and any remaining documentary limits. Do not claim zero partials unless all relevant chains pass.
